title: Chapter 255 The Disappearing Forward
content:
Chapter 255 The Disappearing Forward

In the direction of Xiaochi Town, Zhang Yang also led 400 cavalrymen and rushed quickly.

Yesterday, he learned that Wang Shuo was going to attack Nanshanji. At that time, Wang Shuo joked that he would ask Zhang Yang to support.

But Zhang Yang did not take it as a joke, but really brought people.

In the afternoon, both armies had already formed their battle arrays.

Neither side chose to launch a sneak attack. In broad daylight, the other side's every move was under the surveillance of both sides, and a sneak attack would not gain any advantage.

Both sides set up their battle arrays, and the battle was about to break out.

Ni Wu led 200 guards and 3,000 people from the Iron Sword Gate, left the main force, and rushed towards Wang Shuo's army.

Less than 500 meters away, more than 3,000 people, just like this in public.

Disappeared!

Everyone in the two armies facing each other looked like they had seen a ghost.

After a brief shock, Wang Shuo was worried that Ni Wu would launch a sneak attack, so he immediately asked Ayub to order the entire army to be on alert.

Wang Shuo still gave the command of this battle to Ayub.

He was responsible for commanding the miscellaneous troops sent by other lords.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo felt something.

He checked the message immediately.

Guan Jie, a spy hidden in the Iron Sword Gate, sent a message.

"Lord, Ni Wu used a group invisibility scroll. Now he is hiding in a valley on the left side of the battlefield."

After seeing this, Wang Shuo deliberately looked around, showing a look of fear and anxiety.

He glanced casually at the valley that Guan Jie mentioned.

Then he told Ayub about this situation and asked him not to alert the enemy.

Wutuk was also confused when he saw Ni Wu disappear, and he just thought that Wang Shuo used magic.

On the Wana Village side, according to the tactics discussed before, Good's archers were the first to go out.

"Crane Wing Formation" was launched.

Good took the lead, and 500 archers spread out in a human shape and rushed towards the enemy formation.

Nanshanji's troops are mainly infantry. Although the gang members have war horses, they have never been trained in cavalry combat, so they can only serve as infantry at this time.

Wutuk is also experienced in battlefield command. He immediately formed a circle to defend against the opponent's charge.

Just when the archers were about to contact the enemy camp, the two wings quickly spread out and began to ride and shoot.

The rain of arrows poured down and countless gang members were injured.

The guards of Nanshanji were of high level, strong defense, and well-protected by armor, so they were almost not injured.

But other members were not so lucky.

Although they were shot, they did not panic.

Those who can survive until now are basically fierce people who have experienced countless battles. One arrow can't scare them.

But the unlucky guy shot by Good was not so easy, and he took most of his life directly.

He didn't have the defense like Wang Shuo.

After a few breaths, there was another round of arrows. They wanted to change their formation and launch a counterattack.

But the cavalry archers quickly split into two teams and bypassed from the side.

The main combat feature of the cavalry archers is the tactic of continuous long-range harassment, retreating when the enemy advances, and advancing when the ground retreats.

It is called "kite flow" for short.

If the opponent does not have effective medium and long-range attacks, or solid defense, it can be directly kited to collapse.

In the end, they were chased and killed.

Good led the cavalry archers and circled around these infantry. As long as they did not change their formation, they could continue to output.

At the same time, the catapults in the distance also began to throw projectiles.

This time Wang Shuo brought a total of 20 catapults, with sufficient long-range firepower, enough to blast open the walls of Nanshanji.

In the circular formation of Nanshanji, dense explosions sounded.

Seeing that the situation was not right, Wutuk immediately asked everyone to disperse and prepare to charge the opponent's formation.

If the opponent is constantly consumed by catapults, no matter how many people there are, they can't stand such a toss.
